26-036 GNPCC Wastewater DAFT Polymer RFP

Share
Closing Time
Tue, 10/27/2026 - 15:00

The Regional District of Nanaimo is interested in procuring Dissolved Air Flotation Thickening (DAFT) polymer for use in the treatment of wastewater at Greater Nanaimo Pollution Control Centre.

Submissions and Questions are to be directed to:

Adrian Limpus
Wastewater Program Coordinator - Operations
Email: alimpus@rdn.bc.ca
